title: Abhi Microfinance Bank Completes IPO Public Subscription & Moves Towards PSX Listing
summary: Abhi Microfinance Bank completes its oversubscribed IPO public subscription, marking a key milestone ahead of its PSX listing on 24 November 2026.
body_markdown:
*After a 1.6x oversubscribed book-building phase, the Bank has completed its public subscription, marking another milestone in its path to becoming a publicly listed financial institution.*


Karachi, Pakistan – 13 November 2026: Abhi Microfinance Bank (AMB) has successfully concluded the public subscription of its Initial Public Offering (IPO), with the public portion achieving oversubscription as well. This follows the successful completion of the book-building phase, which was also 1.6 times oversubscribed, reflecting strong demand from institutional and high-net-worth investors.


With both phases now complete, Abhi Microfinance Bank moves closer to its listing on the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX), scheduled for 24 November 2026, under the ticker symbol “ABHI”.


The Bank’s IPO comprised a total offering of 132 million ordinary shares, with 75% allocated to the book-building portion and the remaining 25%, equivalent to 33 million shares, offered to the general public. The public subscription took place on 12 and 13 November 2026, at a final share price of PKR 15.50 per share, with a minimum application of 500 shares, amounting to PKR
7,750.


The successful completion of both phases marks an important milestone in Abhi Microfinance Bank’s evolution and its ambition to strengthen access to formal financial services across Pakistan.


Founded in 2021, Abhi began its journey with a mission to make financial access a right rather than a privilege. Starting with Earned Wage Access (EWA), the company expanded its offerings across payroll solutions, payroll financing, and SME lending, addressing critical cash-flow challenges for individuals and businesses.


In 2025, Abhi acquired FINCA Microfinance Bank, marking a significant milestone in Pakistan’s fintech landscape and its own evolution from a fintech business into a regulated banking institution. The acquired institution was subsequently transformed into Abhi Microfinance Bank, combining the reach and regulatory framework of a microfinance bank with the technology-led approach and operational agility of a fintech.


Today, Abhi Microfinance Bank operates through a network of more than 110 branches across over 100 cities in Pakistan, extending its reach to underserved communities and businesses.


The Bank’s broader journey reflects its commitment to building a sustainable and inclusive financial services ecosystem.
